description: Job states from spec §11. The backend MUST validate every transition server-side. States are also defined as the JobState enum in shared/api-contracts/api-v1.yaml and as JobState in shared/api-contracts/types.ts — keep all three in sync.

notes.cancelling_to_failed: If the worker hits an error while tearing down a cancelled job, it may land in failed with a sanitized error message instead of cancelled.
notes.failed_to_queued: Retry only: a failed job may be re-queued, preserving source media and project settings (spec §12). No other exit from a terminal state is legal.
notes.progress: progress_percent is real and measurable only. When a stage has no measurable percentage, report the stage label with indeterminate progress — never a fabricated number.
notes.rendering_to_validating: Allowed when captions are disabled for the job (captioning step skipped).

title: Magician Clipper — Processing Job State Machine
